searchText: My argument is that requiring the param pre-Electra makes the endpoint confusing for users And developers have to either ignore the param pre-Electra (your way) or check for it's existence post-Electra (my way). Either way there is some overhead for devs, but in my version using the endpoint doesn't add friction. I think it's a one-time effort to communicate to users regarding v2 endpoint usage pre and post electra. Users who didn't receive this communication can continue to use v1 though not ideal Or we don't deprecate v1 until a later time The next release of beacon api will likely be just a few weeks before the fork, having it marked as deprecated in the development version shouldn't be a signal to consumers to use v2 instead as all clients might not even have it implemented yet
